message.content: The sculpture most frequently cited as the iconic masterpiece of the 19th‑century art world is **Auguste Rodin’s *The Thinker***.  Although the finished bronze was cast in 1902, Rodin began sculpting the figure in the 1880s, and it quickly became emblematic of the era’s shift toward expressive, psychologically‑charged forms.  Its fame has endured—*The Thinker* is one of the most reproduced and recognized sculptures worldwide, symbolizing the intellectual spirit that defined much of 19th‑century modernism.
